reason: The preregistered SG-1 pruning function on the VV10/NLC grid is not applicable to Kr under PySCF 2.14.0 because its SG1RADII table is shorter than nuclear charge Z=36, producing IndexError before the KrF2 SCF energy is evaluated.

failure_evidence.exception_message: index 36 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 19

amended_global_policy.scope: ALL ligand-dimer and XY2 jobs without element-specific overrides

unchanged_policy: SCF convergence tolerance and max cycles
three ligand dimer starts at 2.0 A
all five XY2 seed rules and scale factors
anti_fit_statement: The amendment is backend-wide and element-agnostic. No candidate-specific branch, rescue, seed, threshold, or known chemistry label is introduced.
epistemic_statement: This amendment is a numerical implementation change made after a backend compatibility smoke failure but before any molecular relaxation-screen result was available. The original preregistration and failure receipt remain part of provenance and are not overwritten.

technical_source.role: Official PySCF documentation/source for Grids.prune options; nwchem_prune is the documented default general pruning scheme.
